subject: [PATCH v5 10/12] mm/page_alloc: retry alloc_contig_pages() when the zonelist is rebuilt

2026-11-01.patch_summary: This patch modifies the alloc_contig_frozen_pages_noprof function to retry when the zonelist is rebuilt during a zone rebuild operation. This change ensures that gigantic hugetlb pages are not allocated in ZONE_MOVABLE, and instead are placed in ZONE_NORMAL. The patch also adds checks for zonelist updates before using each zone, and restarts the walk if it has changed. This approach addresses issues with kprobes holding the walk across online operations, and improves the allocation of gigantic pages.

reviews.author: Zi Yan
reviews.summary: The patch was found to be correct and the author's solution is acceptable. Zi Yan gave an LGTM (Looks Good To Me) and added their Acked-by tag.
reviews.raw_body:
On Sat Oct 31, 2026 at 10:13 PM EDT, Gregory Price (Meta) wrote:
> Onlining the first block of a zone rebuilds every zonelist in place,
> shifting the slots after the new zone.
> alloc_contig_frozen_pages_noprof() approves a slot by the caller's gfp
> and nodemask, then loads the zone from it:
>
>   CPU 0                             CPU 1
>   alloc_contig_frozen_pages_noprof(GFP_HIGHUSER | __GFP_THISNODE)
>     slot 0 (NORMAL1) approved
>                                     online_pages()
>                                       build_all_zonelists()
>                                         [NORMAL1]
>                                         -> [MOVABLE1, NORMAL1]
>     zone = zonelist_zone(slot 0)    /* MOVABLE1 */
>     alloc_contig_frozen_range(MOVABLE1 pfns)
>
> A gigantic hugetlb page can then land in ZONE_MOVABLE, and a nodemask
> caller can get a range from another node.  Gigantic pages are kept out
> of ZONE_MOVABLE since commit 79b63f12abcb ("mm, hugetlb: do not allocate
> non-migrateable gigantic pages from movable zones").
>
> Check zonelist_update_seq before using each zone, and restart the walk
> if it changed, as the hugetlb pool walk does.  Check again before
> escalating to the pass that may migrate hugetlb pages, so a pass a
> rebuild cut short is redone rather than escalated.
>
> With kprobes holding the walk across the online, the base kernel put the
> 1G page in ZONE_MOVABLE in 3 of 3 runs, and this change put it in
> ZONE_NORMAL in 3 of 3.  Direct GFP_KERNEL calls with nodemask {1} and
> {2} got a ZONE_MOVABLE range and a node 1 range on base, 3 of 3 each,
> and neither with this change.
>
> Fixes: 5e27a2df03b8 ("mm/page_alloc: add alloc_contig_pages()")
> Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
> Signed-off-by: Gregory Price (Meta) <gourry@gourry.net >
> Reviewed-by: Vlastimil Babka (SUSE) <vbabka@kernel.org>
> ---
>  mm/page_alloc.c | 9 +++++++++
>  1 file changed, 9 insertions(+)
>

LGTM.

Acked-by: Zi Yan <ziy@nvidia.com>

-- 
Best Regards,
Yan, Zi

2026-11-02.patch_summary: This patch series addresses issues related to the allocation of contiguous pages in the Linux kernel's memory management system. Specifically, it introduces a retry mechanism when the zonelist is rebuilt during zone onlining. This change aims to prevent gigantic hugetlb pages from being allocated in ZONE_MOVABLE and ensures that the correct zone is used for page allocation.
